title: Substitution witness encoding
statement: For a Boolean list $x$, concatenate, in order: the head of the first component of its first decoded pair; the bit $0$; the shift runs of the two encodings formed from the empty list and the remainder of that first component, and from the scan encoding of that component and the remainder of the second component; the bits $1011$; the scan encoding of the first component with its first bit removed; the bit $0$; the concatenated scan encodings of the first and second components with their first bit removed; and the bits $00$.
caveat: The pair decoding, head and remainder operations, scan operation, shift run, and scan encoding are not defined in the supplied snippet.
